name: Cheesy "Antipasti" Frittata with Prosciutto & Pine Nut-Arugula Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches, add the prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for the frittata.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Roughly chop olives. Place in a large bowl.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers and artichoke hearts. Add both to the bowl with the olives along with eggs, Italian seasoning, and salt. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
18 eggs
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, about 4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a clean large bowl along with pine nuts and dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula
¾ cup pine nuts
⅓ cup Italian salad dressing

instructions.primary_message: Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates; crumble crispy prosciutto over top. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
